g500.mechanic: Velvet Eclipse Theatre. Observation is a deterministic actuator rather than passive information: changing the eye or a curtain changes exactly which opposite-temperament puppets a later pulse advances. Curtain evidence is not awarded for a decorative tap or an out-and-back toggle; the curtain must remain changed and materially change an actual pulse relative to its stored pre-toggle mask, while later temperament knots reverse the policy that must be planned.
